annotation.justification: The clause unambiguously states that a client should not generate content in a GET request unless the request is made directly to an origin server that has indicated that such a request has a purpose and will be adequately supported. The wording does not permit two materially different implementation behaviours, nor does it omit a concrete constraint that would change the operational interpretation.
